cli.error.launchFailed: The captured command could not be started.
cli.error.capturePreparationTimedOut: ViberMate could not finish preparing this capture in time. Check the desktop app for a pending client-trust decision, then try again; the command was not started.
cli.error.environmentNotFound: The selected Environment does not exist. Create and publish it in ViberMate, or omit --env for transparent capture.
cli.error.environmentUnavailable: The selected Environment is disabled or unavailable. Enable or repair it in ViberMate before trying again.
cli.error.captureContextUnavailable: The current proxy and trust details could not be loaded. Check that ViberMate is running, then try again.
cli.error.captureCreateFailed: The manual capture was not created. Review the current details and try again.
cli.error.captureDeliveryFailed: The manual capture was created, but its one-time proxy password could not be written completely. Open ViberMate, find the capture, and rotate it; do not create another one blindly.
cli.error.captureOutcomeUnknown: ViberMate could not confirm whether the manual capture was created. List captures before trying again; do not blindly repeat a one-time secret request.
cli.error.runtimePathUnavailable: The local ViberMate runtime path is unavailable.
cli.error.runtimeUnavailable: ViberMate is not running. Open the desktop app first.
cli.error.loginFailed: Runtime Server login failed. Check the server address, username, password, and transport, then try again.
cli.error.logoutFailed: Runtime Server logout could not be confirmed. Check the connection and retry so the Server session is revoked.
cli.error.remoteLoginRequired: This Runtime Server requires a login. Run vibermate login --server <same-host:port>, then retry the command.
cli.error.terminalCommandFailed: The managed terminal command could not be changed. Open ViberMate Settings to inspect the conflict.
cli.usage:
Usage:
  vibermate login --server <host:port|http(s)://host:port>
  vibermate logout --server <host:port|http(s)://host:port>
  vibermate run [--server <host:port|http(s)://host:port>] [--env <environment-id>] -- <command> [args...]
  vibermate capture create --env <environment-id> --name <name> [--client cli|desktop-app|other] [--expires-in 24h|--until-revoked] [--yes] [--format human|shell]
cli.usage.captureCreate: Usage: vibermate capture create --env <environment-id> --name <name> [--client cli|desktop-app|other] [--expires-in 24h|--until-revoked] [--yes] [--format human|shell]
